_workflow_note.how_to_resume: Start a new Claude session in this project and say: '激活 ToTra GTM 内容工作流，读取 docs/articles/tracker.json 和 content-plan.json，写下一周文章并设置下一次 Cron。'
what_claude_will_do: Read tracker.json to find current_week and next_article_week
Read content-plan.json to get the next week's topic, audience, key_points
Update tracker.json: increment current_week, move completed article to completed_articles
Send a push notification via PushNotification tool telling you the article is ready and what to post
Set a new Cron for the following week
